description: Booking.com guest reviews featured on a city page (e.g. us / new-york): hotel reviews with hotel name, hotel guest score and review count, reviewer name, country and traveller type; guests' reviews of the city itself (score out of 10); and the highlighted review of each top hotel. Typically 10-25 reviews in total; it is the selection Booking.com shows on the city page, not a hotel's full review history. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. new-york, paris, barcelona

country.description: Two-letter country code as in Booking.com city URLs, e.g. us, fr, gb

name: travel_booking_com_reviews
title: Travel Booking Com Reviews
